label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: 3M Open Field Finalized
items.text: The 2026 3M Open will feature 144 players at TPC Twin Cities, including World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler and defending leader Kurt Kitayama, with competitors from 21 countries.

items.headline: Proposed Major Rule After Bryson Snubs
items.text: A new major championship rule is proposed to require players to attend post-round media interviews or face penalties, following Bryson DeChambeau's repeated refusals to speak to reporters in 2026, including at The Open Championship.

items.headline: TPC Twin Cities Course Recovery
items.text: TPC Twin Cities recovered from winter turf injury and is set as a demanding par-71, 7,431-yard test with water hazards on 15 holes for the upcoming 3M Open.
